title: Iran Pledges to Defy Trump’s Economic Sanctions
summary: Analysts say Tehran could intensify the dispute militarily after the United States announced new efforts to squeeze Iran’s economy. One Iranian official vowed that “not a single drop of oil” would leave the gulf.
